parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of MDF, forming the front panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the access point to the cabinet’s interior, allowing users to open and close the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the cabinet frame, enabling swinging motion for opening and closing.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet frame made of plywood, forming the structural body of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and stability to the cabinet, holding the door and shelves in place.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is the internal shelf made of particle board, positioned horizontally inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items, dividing the cabinet’s interior into multiple storage levels.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed in place but can sometimes be adjusted or removed depending on the cabinet design.
